purpose:
N33 paired capture: genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs for the Starlark interpreter error
texts changed by N33 (argument binding, unknown fields, operators, undefined names, call-argument
and builtin parameter texts). Each probe is one package whose BUILD loads `t.bzl` (or, for BUILD
probes, the BUILD itself); `query //pNNN:all` fails while loading it. The compared value is the error
message only: Bazel's `Error[ in NAME]: MSG` line (plus continuation lines) or its resolver
`ERROR: FILE:L:C: MSG`; native's `error: MSG` (traceback layout and the `Error in NAME:` prefix are
out of scope). Harness after artifacts/n22-capture.py of bazel-parity-repr: --batch,
--ignore_all_rc_files, private output roots under /tmp/opencode, env -i, umask 022, private registry
copy of tests/fixtures/builtin_modules/registry, scratch removed. Writes
tests/fixtures/interpreter_wording/reference_receipt.json. Evidence only; no test reads it.
environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, private HOME/TMPDIR, umask 022
normalization: workspace/base/scratch paths replaced by <WS>/<BASE>/<SCRATCH>; messages compared byte-exactly, except that native's `fail: ` display prefix of fail() errors is removed (Bazel frames it as `Error in fail: `); successful probes compare their N33PRINT lines

mismatch_classes.D/star_overwrites_named: probe defect: the probe assigns x and the harness appends `x = 1`, so Bazel reports the resolver error "'x' redeclared at top level"; Bazel's acceptance of an *args element overwriting a named parameter (Eval.java:716-741 adds named before *args, addPositionalArg has no duplicate check) stays documented from source only
mismatch_classes.B/len_too_many, B/depset_too_many: BuiltinFunction.addPositionalArg type-checks each positional argument before the count check (BuiltinFunction.java:307-319); native checks types after binding
mismatch_classes.B/find_unexpected_keyword, B/startswith_: starlark-rust parameter names (needle/prefix/a1) differ from Bazel's (sub/sub/start_or_stop); the hint follows the names
mismatch_classes.B/join_not_iterable: Bazel types join's `elements` parameter (in call to join() ... want 'iterable'); native iterates first
mismatch_classes.O/compare_structs: semantic: starlark-rust orders struct values, Bazel's StructImpl is not Comparable

post_capture_changes: after run 2 (not re-captured): depset(direct/transitive) and Args.add_all/add_joined `values` accept range() as a Bazel Sequence (RangeList); no captured probe passes a range there

after run 2 (not re-captured): bazel-rs uses the vendored SpellChecker port (starlark::errors::bazel_suggest/bazel_did_you_mean/bazel_edit_distance, UTF-16 units) instead of its local ports; captured hints are ASCII and unchanged
after run 2: docs only — fail(stack_trace=False) still prints the native traceback; undefined-name hint ties resolve in sorted order (Bazel: HashSet order)
